slider.titulo-1: Nourishing the Future with Science and Purpose
slider.subtitulo-1: Sustainable and healthy products with traceability and ethics
slider.parrafo-1: Leonardi Global S.L. selects sustainable, healthy, and ethical products with complete traceability. We promote wellbeing, fair trade, and regenerative agriculture in Europe. Every decision we make is guided by a purpose: to elevate people's health and care for the planet's balance.
slider.titulo-2: We curate what the world consumes
slider.parrafo-2: At Leonardi Global S.L. we believe that every product can change the world. Our mission is to introduce to the market only goods that combine health, sustainability, and ethics
slider.frase-2: "It represents an investment in people's wellbeing and the planet's future."

servicio.parrafo: At Leonardi Global, we are the bridge between science, nutrition, and sustainability. We carry out rigorous curation to identify, select, and promote those products and projects that offer real health to the consumer, transparency, and respect for the environment.
servicio.vision-parrafo: To be a European benchmark in responsible wellbeing, science-based certification, and technology applied to traceability, building a global network that chooses health, clarity, and positive impact.
servicio.mision-parrafo: Our mission is to promote the wellbeing of people and the planet, integrating scientific evidence, sustainable nutrition, and responsible practices throughout the value chain.
servicio.trabajo-parrafo: We work alongside producers, brands, and distributors to nourish society with awareness, transparency, and commitment, maintaining a quality standard that integrates sustainability with innovation.
servicio.confianza-parrafo: Every product we certify is an investment in the future: in the conscious work of those who produce ethically and in the wellbeing of those who consume with purpose.

about.subtitulo: We curate what the world consumes
about.parrafo-1:
At Leonardi Global S.L. we believe that every product can change the world.
Our mission is to introduce to the market only goods that combine health, sustainability, and ethics.
Each item we select represents an investment in people's wellbeing and the planet's future.

proposito.parrafo: We exercise rigorous curation of natural and sustainable products, ensuring that each consumer choice has a positive impact. We seek to build a more humane value chain, where nutrition, transparency, and environmental responsibility are the pillars of growth.

ejes.eje-1-parrafo-1: We defend clean and transparent food. Our products are characterised by:
ejes.eje-1-item-3: Balance between flavour, health, and ethical origin.
ejes.eje-1-frase: Every product is an invitation to live more consciously and healthily.
ejes.eje-2-parrafo-1: As an agent in the value chain, we demand complete traceability and verifiable certifications. We work with producers who practise:
ejes.eje-2-item-2: Fair trade and ethical labour practices.
ejes.eje-2-frase: You know where what you consume comes from, and whom you're helping with each purchase.
ejes.eje-3-parrafo-1: Our responsibility begins at the origin and ends at your table. We select partners who drive:
ejes.eje-3-frase: Caring for the planet can also be an everyday decision.

productos.subtitulo: Your digital ally for a healthy and sustainable lifestyle
productos.modal-detox-parrafo: Renew your energy from within with a pack created to accompany natural purification processes. Noble ingredients, functional infusions, and light snacks that help reduce inflammation, balance digestion, and recover the lightness your body needs. Ideal for resetting habits or starting a more conscious path.
productos.modal-detox-uso: Recommended use: 1 sachet per day on an empty stomach for 30 days.
productos.modal-saciedad-parrafo: If you're looking to keep hunger at bay without going through deprivation, this pack is for you. Ingredients rich in fibre, plant proteins, and healthy fats that prolong satiety, stabilise energy, and reduce cravings. Ideal for those seeking to regulate anxiety or accompany intermittent fasting.
productos.modal-saciedad-uso: Recommended use: 1 capsule 30 minutes before main meals.
productos.modal-energia-parrafo: For demanding days or active routines. This pack combines premium herbs, superfoods, and functional snacks that increase vitality in a balanced way, without peaks or crashes. Ideal for students, professionals, athletes, and those who need real, clean, sustained energy.
productos.modal-energia-uso: Recommended use: 1 capsule in the morning or before training.
productos.modal-pausa-parrafo: A kit created for those seeking moments of calm amidst daily rhythm. Infusions that relax, flavours that comfort, and soft foods that invite you to slow down. Perfect for self-care rituals, conscious pauses, and deep rest.
productos.modal-pausa-uso: Recommended use: 1 capsule 30 minutes before sleep.
productos.modal-performance-parrafo: Ideal for those who train or practise recreational sports. Promotes sustained energy, muscle recovery, and natural performance thanks to protein snacks, balanced herbs, and anti-inflammatory infusions. The perfect ally for your physical activity.
productos.modal-performance-uso: Recommended use: 2 capsules before and after training.
productos.modal-digestivo-parrafo: A pack designed for those seeking to harmonise their digestion. Gentle blends, balanced herbs, and light snacks that help reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support a sensitive digestive tract. Ideal for daily use.
productos.modal-digestivo-uso: Recommended use: 1 capsule with each main meal.
productos.modal-glow-parrafo: Beauty begins with what we consume. This pack combines antioxidants, vibrant infusions, and superfoods that nourish from within, supporting skin, hair, and hormonal wellbeing. Ideal for those who want a natural and sustained glow.
productos.modal-glow-uso: Recommended use: 1 capsule daily with breakfast.
productos.modal-familiar-parrafo: The perfect pack for households seeking to replace processed snacks with more natural and tasty options. Varied products, suitable for all ages and designed to improve habits without complications. Ideal for snacks, school, and family moments.
productos.modal-familiar-uso: Recommended use: 1 capsule daily for adults, ½ capsule for children over 6 years.
productos.modal-premium-parrafo: The pack that reflects a lifestyle. For those seeking premium, organic, and responsibly sourced foods that accompany conscious habits. A balanced and curated selection to live in harmony with what you consume
productos.modal-premium-uso: Recommended use: 1 capsule twice a day with meals.
